course.title: TV Engineering
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A factory manufacturing televisions has four units A, B, C and D. The units A, B, C, and D manufacture 15%. 20%, 30% and 35% of the total output,respectively. If was found that output of their televisions 1%, 2%, 2%, and 3%, are defective. A television is chosen at random from the total output and found to be defective. What is the probability that it come from unit C?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
